findings.title: fused first beat of the formula
findings.claim: The opening bi is heard and written already attached to ism, making dependence on a name perceptible from the first beat.
findings.mechanism: QAC prefix 1:1:1:1 joins the name stem 1:1:1:2 in one surface word; this audible and graphic contact gives the opening relational force before a separate action has been stated.
findings.reader_payoff: The formula begins in attachment, and its first syllable already anticipates what follows.
findings.containment: No overt verb is inserted into the Arabic; the sound observation does not establish a separate lexical branch.

epistemic.reason: The aligned local surface and supplied word evidence support this relation.

findings.title: instrumental, locative, accompanying, and binding pressure
findings.claim: Bi lets the unstated act be heard as performed by, in, with, and in attachment to the name, within one governed invocation.
findings.mechanism: The particle at 1:1:1:1 governs ism at 1:1:1:2; the latter's construct with 1:1:2:1 confines the instrumental, locative, accompanying, and binding pressures to the relation between act and divine designation.
findings.reader_payoff: A single translated preposition cannot display the invocation's full supplied relational range.
findings.containment: These are coexisting pressures within one construction, not four independently asserted propositions or a physical location inside a name.

epistemic.reason: The supplied reading survives with its stated inferential, source, or apparatus limits.

findings.title: unspoken act governed through the name
findings.claim: The formula leaves the act unspoken, so beginning, reciting, or invoking can supply the act to which the name is attached.
findings.mechanism: Bi at 1:1:1:1 requires a governing relation while its overt complement ism at 1:1:1:2 specifies the medium. With no expressed governing verb, the present act of utterance supplies the missing action without replacing the words.
findings.reader_payoff: The listener participates in completing the invocation, and the same wording can accompany different beginnings.
findings.containment: No one reconstructed verb is selected as uniquely correct, and no subsequent act or outcome is supplied.

epistemic.reason: The aligned local surface and supplied word evidence support this relation.

findings.title: name as raised or marked designation
findings.claim: Ism identifies the referent by raising it into mention or marking it into distinctness; the invocation puts this designation in an operative relation to the beginning.
findings.mechanism: The name stem 1:1:1:2 meets both the governing bi and the determinate referent 1:1:2:1. The naming branch's elevation explanation makes mention salient; the supplied split marking field permits a bounded analogy with an identifying impression.
findings.reader_payoff: Naming becomes an act of making affiliation distinct, while the ordinary sense remains name.
findings.containment: Elevation is the supplied etymological explanation, not physical ascent. Marking is a physical-sign analogy applied to naming, not a claim that ism literally denotes a brand or that its QAC root changes.

findings.title: Beginning under a raised merciful designation
findings.claim: The invocation can place the next act under a raised divine designation, with the paired mercy terms giving that designation its governing manner.
findings.mechanism: Bi leaves the governing act unspecified and routes it through ism. Naming raises Allah into explicit mention, the proper name fixes the invoked referent, and the two mercy forms specify how that name is presented. Together these contacts shift a prefatory identification of a merciful deity into a portable way of placing an act under a merciful designation.

findings.containment: The act is implied, not identified. Raised means made salient in mention, not spatially elevated; governing manner is the attributed ethical orientation of invocation, not a grammatical adverb or a guarantee that the subsequent act is merciful. Allah remains genitive rather than a grammatical vocative.

epistemic.reason: The HFT record is reconstructed and legacy_unbound. Its coordinates agree with the independently aligned focus, and exact branch semantics are supplied; the synthesized operation remains attributed inference, with no claim of an observed reader response or actual subsequent conduct.

Cover gives an encompassing boundary; the womb gives an interior in which something begins and is sustained before emerging; the common-birth basis of kinship makes this protection relational. The combined reading shifts appended mercy adjectives into the image of an act beginning within a sustaining relation.
